actions: Audited public CPO mask-builder and trainer traversal APIs at release commit 9429452cb536a9e713b73b91c0011b96df44962c.
Bound public 4B launcher to Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct and release dependency to transformers 4.57.3.
Verified public Qwen3-VL-4B tied-embedding configuration and Transformers/PyTorch alias traversal behavior.
Derived conditional dead-mask/ref/index overhead for the tied lm_head alias and separated physical/state_dict/mask-file/trainer-effective accounting.
Persisted calculation artifact, immutable checkpoint, and advanced role-local LATEST by blob-CAS with readback.
material_finding: On the public tied 4B model, CPO's state_dict-based mask builder can retain a duplicate lm_head.weight mask/reference/index entry while CLGRPOTrainer's default deduplicating named_parameters traversal consumes only the input-embedding alias. If the tied embedding moves and the alias receives a full top-10% nonzero mask, the unused alias alone contributes about 0.507 GiB to the current mask file and 0.797 GiB to persistent trainer auxiliary tensors. This source-algebra finding does not apply to public 8B, whose embeddings are untied, and is not yet a measured task_k.pt/RSS result.
exact_next_action: Run the smallest faithful tied-embedding CPO case and record alias storage identity, builder float_keys/total_params/new_mask keys, exact task_k.pt bytes and trainer named_parameters keys; then compare against a storage-deduplicated builder that preserves the same trainer-effective protected physical coordinates.
